verdict.rationale: Sill's privacy page says there is no account and no server, and that screen and keystroke data travel only between your own devices. The one outbound call it documents, a daily update check to api.github.com, can be turned off in Settings › General. Neither page explicitly says Sill collects no analytics or usage telemetry, so the claim of no tracking is implied rather than stated. Missing for 10: explicit first-party statement that no telemetry or usage analytics are collected, a documented complete list of network connections, independent or hands-on verification.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking

citations.quote: There is no account and no server: your screen and what you type travel only between your own devices
Unless you turn off “Check for updates automatically” in Sill’s Settings › General, once a day it asks GitHub (api.github.com) whether a newer version of Sill has been released
